_comment: THE SURPLUS CYCLONE (cast/cycle order item 4, 2026-10-29): the SEARCH can cycle the surplus Unpredictable Cyclone BEFORE
casting the other one in the same turn. After the first Cyclone resolves, cycling the second walks to the next ENCHANTMENT
(there is none) and draws nothing, so the only round-3 kill is: cycle Cyclone #1 as a PLAIN draw (finds the Street Wraith on
top), cast Cyclone #2, cycle the Wraith -> the walk casts Emrakul (extra turn, 15 flying) -> the 15-life opponent dies in
ROUND 3. A cycle seed runs after its plan's casts, so the line is a SEED-ONLY plan whose site-4 re-solve casts the Cyclone
and cycles the Wraith. FOUR Mountains: with three Mountains + four Islands the same line is NOT found at any budget (b0
included) -- the seed's {2} is paid before the continuation exists and the payer spends Mountains, so the continuation
cannot pay {R}{R} (ledger Q61). No lever needed here.
